race.comment: FELIS CHAUS (4) progressed nicely last time out to finish just a neck from the winner in second over 1212m at this track after being in contention on the corner. Finds a suitable race and can play a major role. WILD MONARCH (9) showed good early dash and stalked the pace last start before drawing clear to score by 2 lengths over 1000m at Taree. Among the top chances again. LORD VETTORI (1) got too far back here first-up but finished full of running into midfield. Is sure to have come on from that and if he can settle closer he can give this a big shake. TORQUE SO HOT (2) showed early speed from a good draw last start then battled on well for third, beaten 1.2 lengths, over 1430m at Grafton. In the right race and is a key runner. DIRTY DOES IT (7) drifted back and never threatened when eighth last start over 1212m at this track. Is better than that.
